[[File:Rivoche-Tarkins-brooch.jpg|thumb|right|Rivoche Tarkin's brooch]]
'''Rivoche Tarkin's brooch''' was a customized [[ZZip Product Concepts Limited|zZip]] [[Personality Series ChaumScanner 5]] [[Poison/Legends|poison]] detector, disguised as a [[Sapphire/Legends|sapphire]] [[Brooch/Legends|brooch]] in an ornamental setting. It was given to [[Rivoche Tarkin]] by the [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]], and was designed to subtly warn her when an integrated [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] detected chemical or biological toxins. The sapphire contained a [[Hologram/Legends|holo]] of the [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin family]] crest deep within it, and this stone became her favorite jewel.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>

When Tarkin became a deep-cover [[operative]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], she had her brooch modified to hold a tiny, undetectable [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]], which she could activate with a simple touch while flirting with prospective marks.<ref name="CRO" />
